order_wins: **Highway Infrastructure** -- signs the Contract Agreement for the Palayam (Tamil Nadu) toll plaza on NH-44 following its 23-Oct LOA, Rs 340.08 cr one-year user-fee collection plus toilet-block upkeep.
**Highway Infrastructure** -- signs a second Contract Agreement for the Baiti Kala (UP) toll plaza on NH-731 following its 26-Oct LOA, Rs 91.78 cr one-year user-fee collection.
**Dilip Buildcon** -- Letter of Acceptance for the Gurugram Metro Corridor depot-cum-workshop (Sector 33), Rs 419.47 cr, 21-month completion.

**Midwest Energy** -- selected as successful bidder for a 1,200 MTPA rare-earth permanent-magnet project under the government's Rs 7,280 cr REPM scheme; receives an LOI, must post a Rs 40 cr performance security within 90 days before the Letter of Award, value not stated as a lump sum.
**Viviana Power Tech** -- Rs 124.00 cr turnkey contract from Dakshin Haryana Bijli Vitran Nigam for 11kV distribution infrastructure under RDSS (~17.7% of mcap).

**Aurionpro Solutions** -- wins an additional ~Rs 100 cr data-centre order from an existing global hyperscaler client in Southern India, taking the relationship past Rs 400 cr aggregate (~3.3% of mcap).
**East India Drums & Barrels** -- Rs 33.99 cr LOA from Indian Oil for bitumen drums at its Mathura plant, 3-year supply (~16.4% of mcap).
**RMC Switchgears** -- Rs 18.51 cr LOA from KRYFS Power Components for FSP/MSP/SFU/meter boxes, 60-month execution (~10.3% of mcap).
**3i Infotech** -- Rs 24.48 cr 3-year IT facility-management order from an undisclosed Indian bank (~6.3% of mcap).
**Dhruv Consultancy Services** -- Rs 8.15 cr LOA for Independent Engineer consultancy on the Western Bhopal Bypass (HAM), 50-month term, via a joint bidding consortium with ICT and MVK Infrabuild.
**BMW Ventures** -- Rs 9.07 cr purchase order from Neelachal Ispat Nigam for prefabricated pile cages, 6-month execution (SME, ~1.6% of mcap).
**Virtual Galaxy Infotech** -- Rs 3.65 cr order from Bhandara District Central Co-operative Bank for SD-WAN/cybersecurity, 3-year term (SME, ~1.3% of mcap).
fund_raises_fresh_equity: **Shreedhar Spinners** -- Board approves a proposed preferential issue of up to 20,84,000 convertible warrants at Rs 163 (Rs 33.97 cr), subject to EGM approval 19-Dec.
equity_allotments: **Paisalo Digital** -- allots 1,85,08,963 equity shares on conversion of 10,000 FCCBs, taking paid-up capital to Rs 95.86 cr.
m_and_a: **UCAL** -- wholly owned subsidiary Ucal Polymer Industries buys 66.13% of fellow subsidiary Ucal Electronic (ECU/PCB maker, Pune) from promoter Carburettors Limited for Rs 41.33 cr cash, a related-party deal at arm's length (~13.4% of mcap).
**Beta Drugs** -- forms a 49:51 oncology JV with Algeria's IMGSA Groupe; the JV will take over IMGSA's oncology formulation plant for US$8.7 mn, extending a 4-year supply relationship.

**Voltas** -- executes the Joint Venture Agreement (binding term sheet disclosed 14-Aug) with Atomberg Innovation for room air-conditioner compressors; Voltas acquires 50% of JV entity Atomberg Airtech on closing, value not disclosed.

**Power Grid Corporation** -- executes a Share Purchase Agreement to transfer its entire stake in subsidiary CTUIL to Grid Controller of India (Grid-India), continuing the Board-approved (Mar-2026) separation; price to be finalised via a true-up mechanism, not yet disclosed.

**Stylam Industries** -- Board approves acquiring 51% of Haripur Kraft Co (partnership firm, semi-kraft paper) for up to Rs 22.44 cr, a backward-integration move for its laminate business (~0.4% of mcap).

**Cyient** -- subsidiary Cyient Semiconductors to raise USD 10 mn from GlobalFoundries (GFI) via convertible preference shares under a proposed Share Subscription Agreement; Special Situation India Fund/EAAA also party to the shareholders' agreement.
**Advanced Enzyme Technologies** -- buys a further 1.22% of subsidiary JC Biotech for Rs 2.28 cr, raising its stake to 96.94% en route to full ownership.
**ICICI Prudential AMC** -- SEBI approves the transfer of ICICI Securities' PMS business to the Company via slump sale (first disclosed 10-Aug); closing to follow.
**TCM Limited** -- executes a Joint Development Agreement with JV Asset TCM Estates for a 21-plot premium villa project on 2.5 acres at Kalamassery, Kochi; value not disclosed.

**One 97 Communications (Paytm)** -- step-down subsidiary Paytm Singapore approves an investment of up to Rs 200 cr into Funding Societies' subsidiaries, including ~Rs 162 cr for a 19.1% stake in CardUp; subject to due diligence and regulatory approvals.
capex_core: **Oriana Power** -- five subsidiaries win GOBARdhan Scheme approval for five 22 TPD CBG plants (Jhansi, Kheri, Banas Kantha, Buldhana, Ujjain), Rs 750 cr combined proposed investment (~40.2% of mcap).

**Sandur Manganese & Iron Ores** -- plans a ~Rs 280 cr first-phase iron-ore beneficiation plant at Deogiri (3.5 MTPA, Fe content lifted from ~50% to 60%+), targeting 1.0-1.7 MTPA upgraded output; ~25% complete, commissioning Aug-2027, via debt plus accruals.
**Juniper Green Energy** -- commissions the 108.50 MWp solar component of a 75 MW wind-solar hybrid project under its MSEDCL PPA; aggregate operational capacity rises to ~2,952 MWp and ~698 MWh BESS.
**ACME Solar** -- commissions 54.69 MW (100.02 MW solar plus 54.69 MW/265.38 MWh BESS) of its 250 MW NTPC-PPA FDRE project at Kharnai, Rajasthan, COD 21-Nov.
**KRM Ayurveda** -- proposes an 80-bed Ayurveda hospital in South Delhi (East of Kailash), ~Rs 2.25-2.40 cr from IPO proceeds plus accruals (SME).
**Mercury Laboratories** -- pushes back commissioning of its new Jarod small-volume-parenteral plant by about 12 months to December 2027, citing revised Schedule M and GMP compliance work.
business_updates: **Results season** — 104 companies filed results / earnings-call material today (press releases, recordings, transcripts, presentations) — tracked in the Results tab, not itemised here.
**Arvind Fashions** -- its U.S. Polo Assn. brand targets Rs 4,000 cr India consumer sales in FY27 on high-teens growth; India is now its third-largest and fastest-growing global market.
**Susan Electricals** -- discloses Rs 148.90 cr of new orders since 1-Oct (incl Rs 85 cr HT cables/MVCC), order book Rs 203 cr, plus Rs 250 cr more under finalisation (not yet booked).
**Akiko Global Services** -- October consolidated turnover Rs 31.10 cr (+78% YoY); April-October YTD Rs 182.67 cr (+227% YoY).
distress_risk: **Ashoka Buildcon** -- Saudi client Diriyah Company cancels the ~Rs 846.38 cr (SAR 351.37 mn) Diriyah II hotel-construction JV contract awarded Feb-2026, citing the employer's internal reasons; company seeks clarification.

**Tips Films** -- promoters Kumar S. Taurani and Ramesh S. Taurani issue an Initial Public Announcement under SEBI Delisting Regulations, expressing intent to voluntarily delist the company; offer price/terms not yet stated.
**Orient Green Power** -- APTEL rules for subsidiary Beta Wind Farm, setting aside an APERC order and directing APSPDCL to release ~Rs 12.98 cr of withheld wind-power payments plus interest.
**Sukhjit Starch & Chemicals** -- ITAT cuts its AY2024-25 tax demand from Rs 3.75 cr to Rs 67 lakh and reduces the AY2020-21 demand to nil; AY2018-19 remanded for fresh adjudication.
**NHPC** -- settles the Parbati-III arbitration with Patel-L&T Consortium at Rs 42.62 cr, against the Rs 256.10 cr originally claimed; amount paid 17-Nov, both sides withdraw claims.
**India Cements** -- Supreme Court dismisses Zuari Cement's final appeal, upholding a Rs 26.40 cr arbitral award plus interest from a 2002 marketing-agreement dispute; recovery proceedings to follow.
**Neogen Chemicals** -- CGST authorities drop a consolidated Rs 6.97 cr tax demand (plus Rs 54.76 lakh interest) over alleged excess ITC claims; no additional liability now.
**Concord Enviro Systems** -- NCLT Mumbai dismisses a Rs 1.76 cr Section 9 insolvency petition against subsidiary Rochem Separation Systems.
**Zee Learn** -- NCLT disposes of (withdrawn) Yes Bank's Section 7 insolvency petition against the company.

**Vasudhagama Enterprises** -- discloses a Rs 28.53 cr GST show-cause notice (DGGI Bengaluru) alleging gaming-related tax evasion; the company calls the supporting documents forged and is filing a writ petition in Gujarat High Court.

**Atul** -- US Customs and Border Protection opens an investigation into subsidiary Atul USA over alleged transshipment evasion of anti-dumping/countervailing duty on Chinese-origin 2,4-D; impact uncertain, company contests the allegation.
other_notable: **Brigade Enterprises** -- launches Brigade Autograph, a 40-acre integrated development in East Bengaluru (Orion Mall, Hyatt Regency, a proposed hospital, World Trade Center Bengaluru-Whitefield); first residential phase named Floris, value not disclosed.
